sample_unit: infants (559 i-ROP training; 1544 SUNDROP external validation)
models_evaluated: Interpretable ROP risk model using GA, PMA, and AI-derived vascular severity score (VSS) or clinician P-score

links.outcome: Discrimination of model with vascular severity versus gestational age alone for 2-week TR-ROP
links.effect: Adding vascular severity improved AUROC vs GA alone: difference 0.13 (95% CI 0.06-0.19) in i-ROP and 0.08 (95% CI 0.03-0.14) in SUNDROP.
links.quote: Adding vascular severity improved discrimination vs GA alone (AUROC difference 0.13 [95% CI, 0.06-0.19] in i-ROP; 0.08 [95% CI, 0.03-0.14] in SUNDROP).

links.outcome: Model performance on external SUNDROP cohort versus development i-ROP data
links.effect: The threshold achieved 100% sensitivity with specificity 63% in i-ROP and 73% in SUNDROP; performance held in the external cohort.
links.quote: A decision threshold achieved 100% sensitivity with moderate specificity (i-ROP 63%; SUNDROP 73%).

screen.reason: The study develops and externally validates a precision risk model integrating an AI vascular severity score to predict treatment-requiring ROP and tests an alert/decision threshold for simulated risk-based scheduling to safely defer exams.
